changes.title: Three-row Chomp: definitions and uniqueness statement
changes.summary: Defines sorted three-row positions, legal moves that avoid poison, recursively losing positions, and the uniqueness claim for positive rectangular boards.
changes.assumptions: Rows are natural numbers p >= q >= r; a rectangle has n > 0 squares per row. Poison-taking moves are excluded because they lose immediately.

changes.title: Unique winning opening in positive three-row rectangles
changes.summary: For every n > 0, the three-row n-by-3 rectangle has exactly one legal non-poison target that is a losing position for the next player.
changes.assumptions: Only n > 0 remains in the final mathematical statement. All recurrence-model fields are discharged from the recursively defined actual game.
